name: Disk Monitor
author: AlteringUX
description: Live disk usage on the bar with its own panel: the watched mount's percent-full gauge, every real mount's usage, a 10-minute trend sparkline with min/avg/max stats, and the largest subdirectories under a configured path. Engine is ~/.local/bin/omarchy-diskmon; the widget watches diskmon-state.json.

barWidget.description: Disk usage % with a per-mount and trend breakdown
